metadata.description: Skills and Agents Co's catalog of Claude Code plugins for finance, product, sales, marketing, research, and everyday work.

plugins.name: financial-pulse
plugins.description: Bank-agnostic spending analysis — a categorized 30-day breakdown plus 3 actionable things to look into from 60-day trends. Includes connector agents for Grasshopper, Mercury, and Ramp.

plugins.name: product-builder
plugins.description: Skills for building and shipping a product — code review, PR summaries, research, competitor intel, and document drafting.

plugins.name: finance-team
plugins.description: Skills for running a finance function end to end — month-end close, QuickBooks reconciliation, board reporting, spend control, and contract review.

plugins.name: quickbooks-close
plugins.description: The full QuickBooks Online month-end close, six skills deep — revenue/AR, bank and petty cash, expenses/AP, payroll and balance sheet, inventory, and a final closing package.

plugins.name: eta-searcher
plugins.description: Skills for running a search-fund or self-funded acquisition end to end — sourcing, screening, diligence, and investor updates through the LOI.

plugins.name: newsroom
plugins.description: A small newsroom for your Ghost site: a story researcher, a daily roundup writer, and a weekly quality review. Set up once, then run each skill.

plugins.name: pm-guide
plugins.description: Coaching for the product documents PMs write: PRD, one pager, PR/FAQ, status update, launch post, case study, memo, and engineering update. Paste a draft and get one plain sentence, two or three suggestions, and a chance to review again.

plugins.name: marketing-skills
plugins.description: Marketing skills for ad reviews, sales emails, and value propositions.

plugins.name: productivity-skills
plugins.description: Everyday work skills for email, calendar, meetings, Google Workspace, planning, and personal tasks.

plugins.name: finance-skills
plugins.description: Finance skills outside the month-end close, from board decks and invoices to expense tracking and vendor checks.

plugins.name: content-skills
plugins.description: Writing and publishing skills for content calendars, newsletters, a personal knowledge base, and plain human tone.

plugins.name: research-skills
plugins.description: Research skills for analyzing data sets, prepping discovery calls, scraping the web with Firecrawl, and checking LLM visibility.

plugins.name: coding-skills
plugins.description: Coding and design skills for Figma work and startup stack choices.
